security_audit.summary: Most command and reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, TypeScript examples, and payment-demo language. The remaining high-severity issue is secret handling because the skill permits exporting a generated agent private key in a demo package.

remediation.suggestion: Default to omitting private keys from exported packages. Make any testnet key export explicit, warning-backed, capped, and short-lived.

remediation.issue: Generated or imported agent wallets can be mishandled
remediation.suggestion: Prefer generated testnet wallets and never import production keys. Require explicit user confirmation before creating secret-bearing artifacts.
No security fix is required. Consider clarifying that fenced examples are documentation and not commands to run.

content.value_statement: Paid agent demos are hard to design without unsafe wallet authority or unclear receipt handling. This skill gives Codex, Claude, and Claude Code structured patterns for bounded x402 payments and delegated spend.
actual_capabilities: Defines discovery steps for x402-protected HTTP resources before spending.
Models bounded delegated payment policies for ERC-7710 and ERC-7715 flows.
Outlines subscription, pay-per-use API, and adjudicated payment demo patterns.
Specifies receipt, evidence, dispute, and revocation data for demo workflows.
Guides MetaMask approval card preparation without silently granting permissions.
Lists test cases for caps, expiry, merchant mismatch, and replay attempts.
limitations: It is guidance, not a deployed wallet or payment facilitator.
ERC-7710 and ERC-7715 support depends on the target wallet implementation.
Demos should use testnets unless users explicitly approve mainnet caps.
Private key export patterns require strict demo-only handling and tiny limits.

use_cases.title: Prototype paid research APIs
use_cases.description: Design a testnet agent that buys evidence reports through x402 within a weekly delegated budget.

use_cases.title: Plan guarded agent subscriptions
use_cases.description: Separate recurring policy from per-request x402 payments and define caps, expiry, and revocation paths.

use_cases.title: Review payment demo safety
use_cases.description: Check wallet approval, receipt evidence, route allowlists, and dispute handling before showing a demo.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a paid endpoint
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner discovery before any payment authority is created.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this x402-protected endpoint. Identify the route, token, network, price, payee, and asset transfer method. Do not make a paid request.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a bounded payment policy
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for a single testnet service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a bounded ERC-7710 payment policy for this x402 service. Include per-request cap, weekly cap, expiry, merchant, route, and revocation behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Build a browser lab flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced demo planning with wallet approval and exported artifacts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a browser lab flow for Base Sepolia. Include wallet approval, delegated permission storage, x402 validation, receipt storage, and user warnings.

prompt_templates.title: Design adjudicated revocation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced supervision with evidence review and future payment control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an adjudicated x402 payment demo with signed intent, service receipt, spend snapshots, review decisions, and EVM-side revocation or constraint enforcement.

output_examples.input: Inspect a paid evidence report endpoint before spending.
output_examples.output: The response lists endpoint, token, amount, payee, route, and asset transfer method. It also states that no paid request was made.

output_examples.input: Plan a weekly agent research pass on Base Sepolia.
output_examples.output: The response proposes tiny testnet caps, one provider wallet, one route allowlist, seven-day expiry, receipt storage, and dispute handling.

output_examples.input: Add GenLayer review to a delegated payment demo.
output_examples.output: The response defines spend snapshots, review cadence, decision labels, bridge path, and the controller action for constrain or revoke decisions.

best_practices: Start in discovery mode and ask before setting up payment authority.
Keep demo budgets tiny, time-limited, revocable, and tied to one merchant.
Validate receipts, settlement state, and signed evidence before review or dispute steps.
anti_patterns: Do not create unlimited approvals or open-ended agent wallets.
Do not treat x402 as a subscription state machine.
Do not export production private keys or ask users to share private keys.

faq.question: Can this skill make paid requests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It directs the agent to inspect requirements first and ask before creating delegated payment authority.

faq.question: Does it implement x402 or ERC-7710 contracts?
faq.answer: No. It provides demo architecture, policy fields, workflow steps, and safety checks for implementation.

faq.question: Which wallets does it target?
faq.answer: It discusses ERC-7715 wallet permission requests and MetaMask-style approval flows when supported by the target wallet.

faq.question: Should demos use mainnet funds?
faq.answer: Use testnets by default. Mainnet use needs explicit user confirmation, strict caps, and clear receipt validation.

faq.question: How does it handle subscriptions?
faq.answer: It keeps x402 as per-request payment and places recurrence in the delegated spend policy and accounting layer.

faq.question: What is the main security concern?
faq.answer: The demo guidance can export an agent private key. Treat that artifact as a secret bearer capability.
